name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; HF repo created 2026-04-22; report on arXiv 2026-04-26

params.note: report section 4.2.1 and README: 1.6T total, 49B active. HF safetensors 1,598.8B include the MTP module and hash tables.

tokenizer.note: report: the DeepSeek-V3 tokenizer plus a few special tokens

mixers.note: Compressed Sparse Attention: stride 4, each entry gated-pools an overlapping window of 8 tokens with a learned position embedding; an indexer keeps the top 1024
Heavily Compressed Attention: every 128 tokens become one KV entry, dense attention

moe.router: sqrt(softplus) scores, aux-loss-free bias, top-6; first 3 layers route by a fixed hash of the token id

stack.note: config compress_ratios: 128 = HCA, 4 = CSA; every layer also attends to the last 128 tokens uncompressed

steps.label: attn_norm, applied to the mHC read-out of 4 residual streams
top-1024 of 4x-compressed KV, plus a 128-token window and sink logits
all of the 128x-compressed KV, plus a 128-token window and sink logits
mHC write-back: 4 streams mixed by a doubly stochastic matrix
ffn_norm, on a fresh mHC read-out
1 shared + top-6 of 384, SwiGLU clamped at 10; hash routing in layers 1-3

specials.name: mhc
specials.what: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: residual stream widened to 4 copies; a Sinkhorn-projected 4x4 matrix (20 iterations) mixes them around each sublayer

specials.name: csa
specials.what: two compressed-KV attention kinds interleaved (CSA and HCA); KV is one 512-wide head shared by 128 query heads

specials.name: hash_routing
specials.what: experts of the first 3 MoE layers chosen by a fixed table from token id (tid2eid)

specials.name: attention_sink
specials.what: one learned sink logit per head added to the softmax denominator

specials.name: partial_rope
specials.what: RoPE on the last 64 of 512 dims of queries and KV; outputs get RoPE at the negative position

specials.name: qk_norm
specials.what: RMSNorm on the 1536-wide query latent, a weightless per-head RMS on queries, and a weighted RMSNorm on the single KV head

specials.name: grouped_output_projection
specials.what: attention output projected in 16 groups to rank 1024, then to d_model

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: multi-token prediction module of depth 1, configured as in V3; uses sliding-window attention only

specials.name: mxfp4
specials.what: routed expert weights in FP4 (E2M1) with E8M0 scales; most other weights FP8

paper.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence

code.note: official reference: Block.forward (hc_pre, attn_norm, attn, hc_post, then ffn), Attention, Compressor, Indexer, Gate

readme.note: introduction: 1.6T / 49B, 1M context, CSA/HCA, mHC, Muon; MIT

gal.note: entry 'DeepSeek V4-Pro': date, 61 CSA/HCA layers, 6 routed + 1 shared of 384

unknowns.ffn.hidden_dim: no dense FFN layers: every layer holds experts (the first 3 hash-routed)
unknowns.context_length.trained: the report gives the 4K -> 16K -> 64K -> 1M schedule for V4-Flash; this record does not carry it over to Pro

notes: Config rope_theta 10000 applies only to pure sliding-window layers (the MTP layer); the 61 compressed layers use compress_rope_theta 160000 with YaRN (factor 16 over 65,536).
Gallery calls the attention 'MLA-style'; the config has no kv_lora_rank, one 512-wide KV head and a 1536-wide query latent, so mla is left null.

hca.note: no indexer; YaRN factor 16; layers 1-3 hash-routed

csa.note: overlapping windows of 8; indexer 64 x 128 keeps 1024
